theme: The calls are done; one decision is due today.
greeting: The recruiting and governance calls are behind you, Dan. What's left is the December-break decision — your own deadline to shortlist lands today, with an Oct 15 book-by close behind it.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December-break destinations
needsAttention.detail: Your Todoist deadline to pick the shortlist lands today — all four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2, book-by Oct 15. Passports land mid-November, so the clean path is a domestic shortlist; international only on refundable bookings.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is about two weeks past due. Holiday inventory at PWM is the thinnest of the year; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.
